text:
sre-oncall: seeing a sudden spike of auth failures in na-east1 starting ~10:12 UTC, console 502s and all routing to hosted-api failing for some customers

maria: looks like token validation errors, 401 from authz service, large KS error rate

josh: KMS rotation ran at 10:10 UTC (manual cadence). Could rotation have invalidated cached keys?

anika: confirm logs: auth-service logs show KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE and then cache eviction events: `cache:evict user-token` repeatedly

sre-oncall: yeah, cache eviction flooded control-plane routing because auth checks started failing; fallback rules not kicking in cleanly

leo: traffic impact: ~40% 5xxs for webhooks + console users in na-east1, some requests routed to dedicated pools but tokens rejected there too
maria: rolling a quick mitigation: requeueing KMS rotate rollback job, but need to avoid re-encrypting live keys if partial rotation happened
josh: recommend temporary bypass: auth-service -> allow-old-key flag for 5m to let cached tokens validate while we fix KMS state (risky but fastest)
anika: +1 for short bypass; deploying safe patch now. `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/auth-service ALLOW_OLD_KMS_KEY=true`

deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-service v3.4.7-canary with ALLOW_OLD_KMS_KEY=true (rollout 3/3 pods)
sre-oncall: once auth starts accepting old keys, we should see routing recovery; prepping traffic shift to eu-west1 for critical customers as precaution

leo: capacity note: eu-west1 has lower spare GPU pool for Dedicated; if we shift a large chunk we'll hit autoscale limits and see queueing for GPU jobs
maria: let's do weighted traffic shift (10% -> 30% -> 60%) over 15m windows with health checks. config snippet: `route-policy: {region: eu-west1, weight: 0.1, health_check: 5s}`
josh: also patch routing to prefer non-gpu fallback for lightweight inference to avoid burning GPU slots during recovery
anika: patch applied to routing: enabling cpu-fallback for smaller models. Monitoring deck updated.

sre-oncall: auth errors dropped to near-zero after deploy, console 502s trending down :thumbsup:

leo: warning: while shifting, queue depth on eu-west1 stable but GPU utilization jumped to 78%, cost forecast for the hour +18% if we sustain this
maria: cost vs SLA decision: keep shift for 45m then drain back if auth stable. notify growth/ops for billing heads-up

josh: post-mortem action items: 1) improve KMS rotation safety checks, 2) ensure auth cache fallback uses key-version grace window, 3) make routing fallback prefer region with spare GPU by default
anika: I'll own 2) and 1) with security; putting draft RFC in #eng-security today
sre-oncall: adding notes to incident doc. TL;DR: partial KMS rotation evicted auth cache -> token validation failures -> routing/config fallback gaps -> weighted traffic shift + allow-old-key patch mitigated. Closing once metrics stable for 1h

maria: customers restored, we're in steady-state. leaving monitoring for 60m. :white_check_mark:
